title: Democrats hit out at Nvidia and Trump over Huang’s return – US politics live
summary: Possible presidential hopeful Ruben Gallego warns of a ‘bad lesson for corporate America’ while Ro Khanna says ‘rules should apply to everyone’

blocks.text:
Possible presidential hopeful Ruben Gallego warns of a ‘bad lesson for corporate America’ while Ro Khanna says ‘rules should apply to everyone’

  • Congress to grill Huang over ties with China and Trump’s intervention

  • Sign up for the Breaking News US email

Hello and welcome to the US politics live blog.

Nvidia’s decision to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO sends a message “that the national security of this country is not as important as your relationship with president Trump,” Democratic senator Ruben Gallego said.

US ⁠smbassador to Israel Mike Huckabee ⁠has cast doubt ​on whether Washington would end its $3.8bn in annual military aid to Israel by the end of this year, as promised by Trump on the day ⁠of this month’s midterm elections. In his surprise announcement as voters headed to the polls on 3 November, Trump said he had made a deal with prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu several months earlier ⁠to stop providing Israel with around $4bn in annual US funding.

Speaking at the US Department of Justice, Trump railed against the commutations of death row inmates’ sentences by California’s governor, Gavin Newsom. Newsom responded by criticizing Trump for “selling” pardons and for demanding the execution of five wrongfully convicted young New Yorkers of color in 1989.

Jimmy Gomez will resign from Congress after a House ethics report released on Monday found “substantial evidence” that the California Democrat had “engaged in sexual misconduct”, including by “making unwelcome sexual advances and sexual contact toward a House staffer”. The 19-page report from the House ethics committee found that Gomez “made unwanted sexual advances” toward a House staffer on two occasions, “including an incident in which he made sexual contact with her and another in which he was ‘forceful’ with her in his congressional office”.
